ai-era-daily-life.title: Generative AI and Everyday Life: Wellbeing, Work, and Skills Before and After ChatGPT (2015-2026)
ai-era-daily-life.summary: An evidence-based brief comparing the pre-AI era (2015-2022) with the post-AI era (2023-2026) across quality of life, happiness, perceived freedom, stress, job security, the distribution of gains and losses, and the possibility that AI lets non-experts do specialist work.
ai-era-daily-life.post_title: What Has Generative AI Actually Changed in Everyday Life?
ai-era-daily-life.post_summary: The brief separates measurable change from hype: wellbeing aggregates have moved slowly and remain entangled with the pandemic recovery, while the most reliable effects so far are concentrated in work and skills.

key_terms.def: A 0-10 life-evaluation scale used by Gallup and the World Happiness Report to measure how people rate their lives overall.
A judgement-based measure of life satisfaction, kept separate in the report from day-to-day emotional experience.
Day-to-day emotional experience, measured by Gallup's Positive and Negative Experience Indexes.
The share of an occupation's tasks that overlap with what generative AI can do; distinct from actual job displacement.
The research problem of separating AI's effect from other forces such as the pandemic recovery and the cost-of-living shock.

prompt-literacy-ai-era.title: Prompt Literacy in the AI Era: Value, Measurement, and the Accounting Question
prompt-literacy-ai-era.summary: A research brief on the economic and business value of effective human-AI conversation, covering definition and measurement, job-market signals, productivity experiments, and the case for accounting as the vocabulary of the AI era.
prompt-literacy-ai-era.post_title: Prompt Literacy: The New Workplace Skill With Accounting Implications
prompt-literacy-ai-era.post_summary: The brief defines prompt literacy as crafting clear instructions, fixing poor responses, and knowing when a conversation with an AI is worth having - then shows where the evidence supports real economic value.

key_terms.def: The skill of crafting clear AI instructions, fixing poor responses, and judging when a conversation with an AI is worth having.
A prompting technique that asks the model to reason step by step, sharply improving performance on arithmetic and logic benchmarks.
The boundary beyond which an AI system's raw capabilities cannot reliably complete a task; prompt skill matters most inside the frontier.
The accounting and auditing discipline of providing verifiable, evidence-based confidence, applied in the report to AI-era information.
The thesis that accounting, long the language of business, could become the standardised vocabulary for instructing and interrogating AI systems.
